answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a willow bet on surviving 44 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the anchor schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 44 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 8 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
